_doc: Allowlist for `node tools/meta/scan.mjs --text`. Paths are globs over git ls-files; every entry needs a reason. An entry that matches nothing is reported. Keep a file here only when the wording is functional: an API call, an env var, a model id, the scan patterns themselves, or a packed word table.

entries.reason: The scan tool itself: defines the patterns.
The metadata scan: defines tool-name patterns.
Allowlist file: quotes the false-positive word it excuses.
History filter: the pattern has to match attribution trailers so it can strip them. Comments no longer spell the names.
Pre-push guard: the banned-word list is split into fragments, and one fragment is still a model-id prefix the scan looks for.
Verification log of the image script's model ids (the same ids the script sends). Company names and hostnames were removed; the model ids stay because a wrong id fails a live run.
Operational runbook: the env var name and the default model id are what the script reads.
Listening-test protocol: one optional speech model id is named so the test can be repeated. The provider name was removed.
Code that calls the images API. The endpoint, env var and model id are functional; comments no longer name the provider.
Test of the scan tool. The phrases it checks are assembled in the test so the matcher still sees them.
Packed translation word tables. Some word pieces spell a tool name. Changing a piece would break the language pack, so the tables are left as shipped.
